findings.text: [P3] The docstring says a borrowed figure is refused "before anything else is asked of it", but the borrow test at reckon/crew/hold.py:122 runs on the resolved reading, so a borrowed reading past its shelf life asks the probe first (measured: probe asked once, hold refused) while a fresh borrowed reading asks nothing; both borrow tests use fresh readings so the ordering the docstring claims is never pinned, and a stale borrowed reading is the case where a probe call and a hold refusal are one edit apart.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against ac96f615, the first adding reckon/crew/hold.py and tests/test_hold.py and the second appending the plan section and the evidence anchor; the plan diff writes no meta or status line and stays inside the declared paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: All four declared measures are asserted: tests/test_hold.py:87 parametrizes the four omissions separately and asserts raised.value.field with no message inspection, tests/test_hold.py:119 asserts the re-query and the probe's adopted figure, tests/test_hold.py:169 asserts the state unknown directly and then holds nothing, and tests/test_hold.py:227 asserts a borrowed figure yields no hold with the probe never asked.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is a hold that carries the evidence that produced it, and reckon/crew/hold.py:61 defines Hold over group, figure, age_seconds and source while reckon/crew/hold.py:84 resolves the figure through staleness before any hold exists, so the landed module does what the goal states.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the manifest at its own path; its 13-pass gate was reproduced independently at the reviewed revision and both named commits exist, but its evidence_inputs do not mention that the borrow test is never exercised on a stale reading, which is where reckon/crew/hold.py:116 asks the probe before refusing.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff ac96f615f32e5093caea1dd3383d62a678ee8be4..2bf15c90 changes exactly the four paths the manifest declares, 631 insertions and no other path, and no path outside reckon/crew/hold.py and tests/test_hold.py carries behaviour.

justifications.durability: Tests exist that fail when the change regresses, proved by two independent mutations of a scratch copy. logs/hold-teeth-B-constructor-refusal-removed.log shows all four omission cases failing and logs/hold-teeth-A-unknown-guard-removed.log names test_a_failed_requery_yields_unknown_and_does_not_hold.
justifications.evidence: The gate measures what the done_when asserts and its result is recorded, with both singled-out behaviours falsified under removal. logs/focused-hold.log records 13 passed at the reviewed revision and logs/hold-teeth-A-unknown-guard-removed.log shows the named test failing when the unknown guard is deleted.
justifications.fit: The module follows the idiom of its neighbours and introduces no name the naming rules forbid. reckon/crew/hold.py:61 uses the frozen slotted dataclass and underscore helpers of reckon/crew/budget_group.py:31, and no name or comment carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The landed module refuses to exist without its evidence and refuses borrowed and unknown figures, which is the whole of the goal. reckon/crew/hold.py:78 raises per missing fact and reckon/crew/hold.py:122 returns None for a figure whose pool is not the group's.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff stays inside the declared write paths and carries nothing the goal does not imply. git diff ac96f615f32e5093caea1dd3383d62a678ee8be4..2bf15c90 lists only reckon/crew/hold.py, tests/test_hold.py and the two declared docs paths.

measure_assertions.measure: a hold without a named group, figure, age and source cannot be constructed, by requiring the constructor to refuse and never by checking a formatted string
measure_assertions.receipt: tests/test_hold.py:87 deletes one of the four facts per parametrized case and asserts raised.value.field == omitted; a scratch copy whose refusal loop is removed fails all four cases (logs/hold-teeth-B-constructor-refusal-removed.log), and a scratch copy whose message text is rewritten with the field attribute kept still passes 13 (logs/hold-teeth-C-message-rewritten.log), so the check is on the attribute and not on a string.

measure_assertions.measure: a hold computed from a reading past its shelf life is asserted to re-query and adopt the new figure
measure_assertions.receipt: tests/test_hold.py:119 asserts the probe was called once, that the hold's figure is 97.0 and explicitly not the stale 80.0 it replaced, and that the hold's age is the probe's; tests/test_hold.py:147 pins the other half by forbidding a re-query inside shelf life; independent probe reproduced both directions.

measure_assertions.measure: a failed re-query is asserted to yield unknown and to not hold
measure_assertions.receipt: tests/test_hold.py:169 asserts resolved.serving_state == unknown on a direct resolution and then asserts hold is None with the message "a failed re-query was read as a figure and held on", so the non-hold is asserted by identity, never inferred from the state; deleting the unknown guard from a scratch copy fails this test and test_an_unknown_serving_state_does_not_hold, and the reading that remains after the failed re-query is 95.0 against a ceiling of 90.0, which is what makes the None attributable to the unknown guard rather than to a coincidence.

measure_assertions.measure: a borrowed probe reading is asserted never to become a group's position
measure_assertions.receipt: tests/test_hold.py:227 holds a fresh codex-main figure at 95.0 against a spark ceiling of 50.0 with a probe that raises if called, and tests/test_hold.py:249 repeats it with the source key deleted; both yield None and neither calls the probe. Not covered: the same reading past its shelf life, where the probe is asked before the borrow test returns None (measured on the same group and ceiling).
